battle.name: 信州之戰
battle.brief: 廣明元年五月，黃巢屯兵信州，瘟疫，淮南節度使高駢部將張璘乘勢猛攻。黃巢偽意向高駢乞降，誘使高駢撤回昭義、感化、義武諸道援兵，斷絕往來、宣戰。決戰中張璘被殺，淮南精銳盡毀，黃巢打通北渡長江之路。卡上羅馬重步兵雖不在此戰，軍團之制足為對照：重裝不足恃，兵源與補給才是根本。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 交戰一方是唐王朝。僖宗廣明元年三月，唐廷以淮南節度使高駢接替連敗的王鐸，任諸道行營都統，坐鎮揚州，徵得丁壯七萬，並可調動昭義、感化、義武等道的行營兵；但真正的樞紐仍在神策軍與朝廷宦官手中，藩鎮不過借出兵馬，糧餉則仰賴江南運轉。另一方是黃巢起義軍，其骨幹為王仙芝留下的部眾，起義之初以饑民、流民為主，兵眾雜而無編制，黃巢自將中軍，以輕裝騎隊為先鋒，既無文書、亦無固定給養，靠沿途徵糧與繳獲維持。兩造的指揮體系一體一散：唐廷有官銜、有節度使、有軍令節制，起義軍只有旗號與首領的威信；信州一役的勝負，說到底就是在這個差異上決定。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Tang court. In the third month of the Guangming era the court replaced Wang Duo, who had lost general after general and the cities they held, with Gao Pian, governor of Huainan, and made him commander-in-chief of the armies of all circuits. Gao Pian sat at Yangzhou, raised seventy thousand of the local levy, and could draw on the field troops of the Zhao-yi, Gan-hua and Yi-wu circuits; yet the real authority remained with the Shence Army and the eunuchs at court, the circuits merely lent soldiers, and the grain came by river from Jiangnan. The other belligerent was Huang Chao's insurgent army, the successor to the bands of Wang Xianzhi. At the beginning it was made up of famine victims and vagrants, numerous but without organisation; Huang Chao led the centre himself with light cavalry as the spearhead, with no paperwork and no fixed supply system, living off requisitioned grain and captured stores along the road. The two command systems were one ordered and one loose: the Tang had titles, circuit governors and written command, the insurgents had only a banner and the authority of their leader. The outcome at Xinzhou was decided precisely on that difference.
people: 關鍵人物有四位。黃巢是這一戰略的主導者：兵敗退保饒州、又屯兵信州，瘟疫中他決計以詐降拖延，趁高駢自撤諸道兵再突然宣戰。淮南節度使高駢掌著全軍，卻因屢勝而驕，既想獨吞討賊之功，又想以招降賺取全勝，屢次上表誇口黃巢旦夕可平，致令朝廷撤回援兵，戰機由此斷送。前線主將張璘是唯一打通江南、逼近信州的人，銳進追擊時中伏被殺，淮南精銳之師隨之崩解。僖宗李儇雖未臨陣，三月換將、五月准撤援兵都出自他手。起義軍方面，王重霸、常宏先後率部降官軍，使饒州很快失守；諸道節度使奉命調兵淮南，又被高駢一紙奏請遣回。張璘之死與高駢的自私，構成本戰兩個真正的樞紐。
peopleEn: Four men decided the day. Huang Chao was the master of the operational plan: beaten back to Raozhou and then lodged at Xinzhou, with plague in the ranks, he resolved to buy time by feigned surrender, wait for Gao Pian to pull the other circuits' armies away, and then break off contact and declare war. Gao Pian, governor of Huainan, held the whole army, but his run of victories made him arrogant. He wanted the credit for destroying the rebels alone, and he also wanted a surrendered enemy to hand him that credit, so he reported to the throne that Huang Chao would be taken within days; the reinforcements were withdrawn and the initiative was thrown away. Zhang Lin, the forward commander, was the only man who had opened a road through Jiangnan and closed on Xinzhou; pressing the attack too eagerly he was killed in the fighting, and the elite of the Huainan army broke with him. Emperor Xizong, though never on the field, made the decisions of changing the commander in the third month and of approving the withdrawal in the fifth. On the rebel side Wang Zhongba and Chang Hong went over to the government troops, and it was their defection that cost Huang Chao Raozhou. The circuit governors of Zhao-yi, Gan-hua and Yi-wu had already marched their men to Huainan and were then sent home by Gao Pian's single memorial. Zhang Lin's death and Gao Pian's selfishness are the two real hinges of this battle.
kits: 卡牌所配的羅馬重步兵，是古代世界制度化重裝步兵的樣板：共和末期至帝制前期的軍團以十個 cohort 編制，重步兵（hastarii 與 principes）列於第一線，持大盾與分段環片鎧甲，配短劍與標槍，開戰以標槍齊射壓制而後近身纏鬥；這套裝備在八世紀末已隨古典軍團一同消失，信州戰場上不會出現任何羅馬兵械，所以本卡在此戰中是制度對照，而非實戰裝備。實際交戰的裝備另有兩套。唐軍主力是募來的丁壯，多持唐弩與長弓，配皮甲、明光甲與刀、挺，騎兵靠江南馬匹供應，攻城用雲梯、撞車與擲石器械，糧道自揚州及江南諸州順運而下。黃巢軍初起多為徒步行伍，器械簡陋而數量驚人，後大量吸納兩淮與中原的騎兵以及繳獲的官軍弩械，重甲極少，全靠騎兵衝陣與流竄迂迴。兩相比較：一邊是有裝備而無補充，一邊是無裝備而有兵源，勝負由此而定。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Roman legionary, is the model of the disciplined heavy infantryman of the ancient world. In the late Republic and the early Empire the legion was organised in ten cohorts, and the heavy infantry, hastarii and principes, stood in the front rank with the large scutum and segmented ring armour, the short sword and the pilum, opening a battle with a volley of javelins and only then closing to hand-to-hand. That equipment had vanished with the classical legions long before the eighth century, and no Roman arms or soldiers appear on the field at Xinzhou; on this card the legionary therefore stands as a comparison of institutions rather than as equipment actually fought with. The two real kits were of another sort. The Tang troops were levies raised by Gao Pian, most of them with the Tang crossbow and the long bow, in leather and mail, with sabres, spears and lances; their horses came from Jiangnan, their siege train of scaling ladders, battering frames and stone-throwers, and their grain ran down the river from Yangzhou and the Jiangnan prefectures. The insurgents began as foot columns with poor kit and astonishing numbers, then absorbed large bodies of cavalry from Huai and Yang together with the crossbows they captured, wearing almost no heavy armour, relying on the cavalry charge and on fluid movement. Set the two side by side: one had equipment without replacements, the other had men without equipment, and the result followed from that.
tactics: 官軍的戰法是一條江、一座城、一道渡口地守住：張璘渡江追擊，先取饒州，再向信州步步進逼，企圖用持續壓力逼黃巢就範。起義軍採取拖延與流動並用：退保饒州是為了縮短補給線，屯信州是藉城池與疫病拖住追兵，詐降則一面爭取時間、一面離間聯軍，待高駢將昭義、感化、義武諸道兵撤回、聯軍自行瓦解，才斷絕往來、宣戰反擊。決戰前黃巢仍據地利，張璘若待機而進尚可相持，卻因求功心切而前出，遭合圍斬首，隊形一亂，淮南精銳自相踐踏而潰。得勝後黃巢不再糾纏，改採縱深與連續攻擊：六月連下池州、睦州、婺州、宣州四州，清掃渡口周邊；七月集中十五萬大軍於採石一處強渡，兵力一點突破，全軍直趨天長、六合，進抵揚州不足五十里。揚州守軍閉城不出，起義軍至此已由被追擊的一方變成進攻的一方。
tacticsEn: The government's plan was to hold a river, a walled city and a crossing. Zhang Lin crossed the Yangtze in pursuit, took Raozhou first, and then pressed on Xinzhou step by step, hoping that constant pressure would force Huang Chao to terms. The insurgents mixed delay with movement: falling back on Raozhou shortened their supply line, holding Xinzhou used the walls and the plague to pin the pursuer, and the feigned surrender bought time while splitting the allied army. Only when Gao Pian had sent the troops of Zhao-yi, Gan-hua and Yi-wu home and the coalition had dissolved of its own accord did Huang Chao break off contact and declare war. Before the decision he still held the local advantage; had Zhang Lin waited his time the battle could have been a stalemate, but he pushed out in pursuit of glory, was enveloped and killed, and the disordered host trod itself down. After the victory Huang Chao stopped skirmishing and switched to depth and continuity: in the sixth month he took Chizhou, Muzhou, Wuzhou and Xuanzhou in succession, clearing the approaches to the crossings; in the seventh he concentrated a hundred and fifty thousand men at Caishi alone, forced the river in a single point of strength, drove on Tianchang and Luhe, and came within fifty li of Yangzhou. The garrison shut its gates and did not sortie, and the insurgents had moved from the chased to the chasing.
data: 可考的數字有幾組。官軍方面，高駢在揚州徵募各處丁壯七萬，擔任諸道行營都統；參與南調的外道兵至少昭義、感化、義武三道，而被高駢一紙奏請遣回的援兵數目，《資治通鑑》卷二百五十三並未記載。起義軍方面，黃巢屯兵信州時正值五月，軍中瘟疫流行、病亡不斷，但確數未見於書；六月連下池州、睦州、婺州、宣州四州，即今安徽貴池、浙江建德、浙江金華與安徽宣城一帶；七月率軍十五萬自採石強渡長江，採石即今安徽馬鞍山西南的渡口；渡江後直趨天長、六合，距揚州城不足五十里。依《資治通鑑》所記的唐曆，戰役自五月起至七月渡江，前後約三個月。代價方面，淮南節度使部將張璘陣亡，高駢多年徵募的精銳之師全軍覆沒；起義軍雖勝，疫病造成的病亡與渡江損耗都沒有留下數目。唯一明確記載的損失是兩名起義軍部將王重霸、常宏的倒戈，正是他們交出饒州，官軍才取得進攻的跳板。
dataEn: Several sets of figures can be checked. On the government side, Gao Pian raised seventy thousand of the local levy at Yangzhou as commander-in-chief of the armies of all circuits; the outside troops drawn in included at least three circuits, Zhao-yi, Gan-hua and Yi-wu, while the numbers of the reinforcements he sent home by one memorial are not recorded in the Zizhi Tongjian, juan 253. On the rebel side, Huang Chao lay at Xinzhou in the fifth month with plague raging in the camp and the sick dying in numbers, though no total appears in the book; in the sixth month four prefectures fell in succession, Chizhou, Muzhou, Wuzhou and Xuanzhou, that is modern Chizhou in Anhui, Jiande in Zhejiang, Jinhua in Zhejiang and Xuancheng in Anhui; in the seventh month he led a hundred and fifty thousand men across the Yangtze at Caishi, the crossing southwest of modern Ma'anshan, and then drove on Tianchang and Luhe to within less than fifty li of Yangzhou. By the Tang reckoning of the Zizhi Tongjian the campaign ran from the fifth month to the crossing in the seventh, roughly three months. In losses, Zhang Lin, the Huainan commander's officer, was killed and the elite host Gao Pian had raised over years was wiped out; the rebels won, but the plague dead and the wastage of the crossing leave no figures behind. The only recorded loss is the defection of two rebel commanders, Wang Zhongba and Chang Hong, and it was they who handed over Raozhou and gave the government army its foothold.
cause: 起戰有遠因，也有近因。遠因是唐末的結構性崩壞：兩稅法之後州縣失據，農民破產，饑民成群，875年王仙芝起於河南，877年王仙芝死後部眾推黃巢為帥，黃巢轉戰江淮，所到之處官軍望風而潰，遂有席卷江南之勢。近因在官軍內部：878年之後唐廷倚王鐸討賊屢戰屢敗，損將失地，880年三月僖宗改命高駢為諸道行營都統。高駢接手雖連勝，卻存私心，既要獨居討賊首功，也要留降人頭以為己功，遂把已奉命南下的諸道兵遣回。直接點火的是起義軍的絕境：信州疫癘橫行，士卒病亡，張璘又步步逼近，退則被殲於孤城，戰則勝負難料，黃巢於是取賄賂與詐降兩手，一面向高駢稱臣求官、一面等待聯軍自行瓦解。待朝廷接納高駢的欺瞞奏報，黃巢立即斷絕往來、舉兵宣戰，決戰於信州城下。
causeEn: The war has a distant cause and an immediate one. The distant cause is the structural collapse of the late Tang: after the two-tax law the prefectures lost their footing, the peasants were ruined, and famine crowds rose. Wang Xianzhi revolted in Henan in 875; when he died in 877 his troops chose Huang Chao as their leader, and Huang Chao fought his way through the Yangzi region, government troops collapsing before him at every stage, until all of Jiangnan seemed within reach. The immediate cause lay inside the government army. After 878 the court relied on Wang Duo, who was beaten again and again and lost both generals and cities, and in the third month of 880 Xizong replaced him with Gao Pian as commander-in-chief of the armies of all circuits. Gao Pian won easily after taking over, but he was working for himself: he wanted the credit for crushing the rebels alone, and he wanted a surrendered rebel to carry that credit for him, so he sent home the very circuit troops the court had ordered south. What lit the fuse was the extremity of the insurgents. At Xinzhou the epidemic was taking the camp apart and Zhang Lin was closing in; retreat meant destruction in an isolated city, battle was a toss of the dice, so Huang Chao took both the bribe-and-surrender and the delaying hand, offering to serve Gao Pian and ask for an office while waiting for the coalition to come apart of its own accord. Once the court accepted Gao Pian's false report, Huang Chao broke off contact, called his banners and fought the decision at the walls of Xinzhou.
impact: 信州一役是黃巢由守轉攻的樞紐。張璘之死使淮南精銳一空，高駢再無可戰之兵，只能閉城待援，兩淮的藩鎮與州縣失去遮蔽，黃巢於是接連取得池州、睦州、婺州、宣州，並在七月把十五萬人送過長江，直抵揚州近郊。諸道兵被高駢遣回，使唐廷賴以對付叛軍的多道聯軍作戰體系崩解，朝廷不得不靠臨時再募、再調，再猜測將帥意圖來維持戰局。地方層面，江南諸州連遭兵禍，漕運與鹽利受損，糧價騰貴，州縣官府多閉門自守，征發愈重而民心愈離。制度層面，此役暴露晚唐兵隨將、將自重的藩鎮痼疾，也顯示唐代正規軍雖有完整編制，卻缺乏足以承受重大損失的預備兵源，此點正是卡牌上羅馬軍團所標舉的教訓：重裝與陣亡名將都不是持久戰力，補充兵源與補給線才是。此後黃巢乘勢掃清江淮、逼迫東都與西都，終致僖宗西幸蜀中，江淮與中原進入長達數年的戰亂，亂軍所過之處，府庫、里坊、寺觀與農田都遭摧毀。
impactEn: The battle of Xinzhou was the hinge on which Huang Chao turned from defence to attack. With Zhang Lin dead the elite of Huainan was empty, Gao Pian had no troops to fight with and could only close his gates and wait for relief, the circuits of Huai and Yang lost their cover, and Huang Chao took Chizhou, Muzhou, Wuzhou and Xuanzhou in turn and put a hundred and fifty thousand men across the Yangtze in the seventh month to within a few miles of Yangzhou. The other circuits' armies had been sent home by Gao Pian, so the multi-circuit coalition the court depended on dissolved, and the throne could only raise fresh levies, move fresh troops and guess at the intentions of its own commanders to keep the war going. Locally, the Jiangnan prefectures suffered war again and again; the grain tribute and the salt revenues suffered, grain prices rose, county offices shut their doors to protect themselves, and the more they requisitioned the further the people were driven away. Structurally, the campaign exposed the late-Tang disease of troops following their own generals and generals caring only for their own ground; it also showed that the Tang regular army, complete in organisation as it was, had no reserve of replacements able to absorb a blow of that size, which is exactly the lesson the Roman legion on the card stands for: neither heavy armour nor a famous dead general is durable strength, only fresh manpower and supply lines. Huang Chao used this to sweep the Yangzi region, to force the eastern and western capitals and to drive Xizong west to Shu, and the Yangzi and the Central Plains were to be at war for years, with granaries, wards, temples and fields ruined along the road.
result: 結果是官軍在信州城下大敗，張璘被殺，淮南節度使高駢辛苦經營的精銳之師全軍覆沒，官軍追擊線就此中斷。黃巢以詐降換來的時間轉為勝勢：既拆散諸道聯軍，又保住本部主力，隨後橫掃池州、睦州、婺州、宣州四州，於七月以十五萬之眾自採石強渡長江，兵鋒直抵天長、六合，距揚州不足五十里，淮南首府只能閉城上表、假稱中風而不出戰。從整體戰局看，這是黃巢軍從被追擊轉為全線進攻的起點：江淮已無完整防線，中原門戶洞開，官軍再無成建制之師可以攔截。史料上，此役細節主要見於《資治通鑑》卷二百五十三唐紀六十九，所記多為兵勢、渡口與城邑的進退，而少見編制、器械與傷亡的細目，故本戰的裝備與數字只採書中明載者。
resultEn: The result was a severe defeat for the government army below the walls of Xinzhou. Zhang Lin was killed, the elite host that Gao Pian had laboriously raised was destroyed, and the pursuit line was broken in the middle. The time Huang Chao had bought with his feigned surrender turned into a victory: the allied armies were split, his own main force was preserved, and he swept through Chizhou, Muzhou, Wuzhou and Xuanzhou before putting a hundred and fifty thousand men across the Yangtze at Caishi in the seventh month, his spearhead reaching Tianchang and Luhe and standing less than fifty li from Yangzhou, where the Huainan capital could only close its gates, report to the throne, pretend to be paralysed and refuse to fight. In the wider war this was the point at which the insurgents turned from the hunted to the attacking: Jiangnan no longer had a complete line of defence, the Central Plains lay wide open, and no government army in formed units remained to bar the way. The record of the fighting is preserved mainly in the Zizhi Tongjian, juan 253, in the annals of the Tang. It notes the movement of troops, the crossings and the cities taken and retaken, and is thin on formations, equipment and casualties, so for the organisation, arms and figures of this one battle only what the book actually records has been used here.
